about.title: Your Journey Starts Now!
about.subtitle: Lugh World is a cozy MMORPG where you can be whoever you want! Explore, capture creatures, make friends, and live a grand, magical adventure.

anky.text: The daisy on its forehead is used to absorb solar energy, making them move faster. Ankyloseeds also learn to release the stored energy as an attack, reaching considerable distances! When they are born, they stay close to the nest until they evolve.
anky.subText: Fun fact: Be very careful because the parents of Ankylosseeds are extremely territorial and never leave the nest unprotected.

araupi.text: Araupis are extremely eye-catching Lughs because of their colors. Despite their small size, they have a strong beak capable of cutting tree trunks and splitting rocks.
araupi.subText: At this stage of life, they are learning to fly, so they spend most of their time on the ground, but whenever they can, they flap their wings to reach higher branches, which makes them cute yet clumsy Lughs.

carousel1.title: Your best friend!
carousel1.text: Whenever your Lugh is out of the crystal, it will accompany you!

carousel2.title: Swimming
carousel2.text: Swim along Lugh World's beaches! Explore the seas and discover secret islands!

carousel3.title: Customization
carousel3.text: Customize all your character’s attributes and make it perfect for you!

carousel4.title: Spells
carousel4.text: Lughs have unique spells! Use their magic to defeat wild Lughs and collect rare items!

carousel5.title: Evolution
carousel5.text: With each evolution it becomes stronger and gains even better abilities.

q1.question: Why are you creating Lugh World?
q1.answer: We are creating the game we've always dreamed of playing—a cozy and unique MMORPG. We want to deliver a world where you can be whoever you want, full of adventure and fun. Our focus is to foster a collaborative experience among players so they can make friends and explore our world together or solo, as each one prefers! We want Lugh World to be a safe harbor for our players!

q2.question: What does Lugh World aim to deliver to online game fans?
q2.answer: Lugh World is an ambitious MMORPG created by players passionate about adventure and challenges. Our goal is to offer a vast world, full of magic, unique creatures, and engaging stories. Follow the children as they explore a newly discovered world, collecting resources, facing challenges, and evolving alongside their partners.

q3.question: Is there a story in Lugh World?
q3.answer: In Lugh World you will uncover a story as big as your imagination! We plan to create an incredibly immersive experience in which you will follow the story as you progress through the game! There are many important historical points inside and outside the game, both in the creature designs and in our maps! We’re excited to deliver an emotional and groundbreaking story for fans of fantasy worlds!

q4.question: When will Lugh World be ready to play?
q4.answer: We're online now! Lugh World is currently in Early Access on Steam. Our goal is to create an amazing world, full of detail and quality! The entire team is committed and working hard to continue expanding the game and improving the player experience. You can follow the current development stage on our website and Steam page.

q5.question: How can I play Lugh World?
q5.answer: Now any player can experience Lugh World through Early Access on Steam! We believe in the power of creativity and the importance of direct contact with the community. From the beginning, we built the project independently to maintain creative freedom and continue improving the game based on player feedback. Download the game, explore the world of Lugh, and actively participate in building this journey with us!

q6.question: What are the minimum requirements?
q6.answer:
PC requirements: Processor: Intel i3 6100T 3.2GHz or similar

Memory: 4 GB RAM

Graphics card: Nvidia GTX 670 or similar

DirectX: Version 12

Storage: 5 GB available space

q7.question: Which platforms will the game launch on?
q7.answer: Right now our focus is developing the game for PC. In the future we want to make it available for Mobile and Consoles.
